s1.name: Al-Andalus Event Hall
s1.description: A spacious, modern hall that accommodates events of every size, with professional reception service and ample parking. Our team supports you from initial planning through the event itself for a seamless experience with nothing overlooked.

s2.name: Lamsa Photography Studio
s2.description: We capture your moments in an elegant documentary style that blends the natural with the professional. We work with modern equipment and an experienced team to document your event from multiple angles, delivering edited photos within two weeks.

s3.name: Al-Amal Decor
s3.description: We design and set up custom decor that reflects the character of your event, from lighting to flowers and side arrangements. We work with all kinds of spaces and suggest solutions that fit your budget and the space available.

s4.name: Al-Asala Catering
s4.description: Varied menus that blend traditional Algerian dishes with modern touches, customizable to guest count and taste. Our service team handles every detail from preparation to serving.

s5.name: Al-Nagham Band
s5.description: A versatile band suited to all kinds of events, from calm atmospheres to lively evenings. We also provide professional sound equipment sized to your venue.

s6.name: Elegant Invitations Boutique
s6.description: Printed and digital invitation designs with elegant, fully customizable touches, with the option to add matching keepsake gifts. Fast delivery to fit any timeline.

s7.name: Lamasat Beauty Salon
s7.description: Complete beauty and grooming services including makeup and hairstyling by a team trained in the latest techniques. We also offer trial sessions before the event.

s8.name: Al-Nokhba Event Planning
s8.description: We handle your event from A to Z — choosing the venue, coordinating with service providers, and managing the schedule on the day itself. Our team is with you every step of the way for peace of mind.

s9.name: Al-Nour Conference Hall
s9.description: A hall equipped with the latest sound and display systems, suited to conferences and professional events of any size. We also offer hospitality and seating arrangement on request.

s10.name: Golden Frame Studio
s10.description: Professional photo sessions in a cinematic style that highlights the finest details of your event. We also offer printing and custom albums after delivery.

s11.name: Day-of Event Coordination
s11.description: Day-of coordination for those who've planned their own event and need a professional team to execute it smoothly. We liaise with all your service providers and manage the schedule through to the end of the event.

s12.name: Event Videography
s12.description: Full video coverage of your event with professional editing that brings together the best moments in a short film. An unedited extended version is also available on request.
